en: Vintage monochrome postcard showing a panoramic view of a small town with traditional European houses, a church with a tall spire, and several fortress-like towers on a hill behind the town. In the foreground is an empty ploughed field bordered by a wooden fence. Red printed text at the top left reads "Gruß aus Stolpen." and sideways along the left edge is the publisher credit.
